    r1 = max(r for r, c in zeros)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in zeros)
    c1 = max(c for r, c in zeros)
    width = len(grid[0])
    return [[grid[r][width - 1 - c] for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)] for r in range(r0, r1 + 1)]
